turns.text: Lloyd, I'm reviewing the citations for the new paper. Can you check the bibliography?
Sure, Alan. Which section are you looking at?
The related works section. I want to make sure I've grouped the safety approaches correctly.
Understood. What specific grouping are you concerned about?
Well, guardrail safety monitors are related work to Inner Voice. They aren't the same method, just comparable.
Got it. I'll note that distinction for the context.
Also, did the package with the monitor stand arrive yet?
I don't have real-time tracking access, but you can check the shipping link in your email.
Lloyd, I need to adjust the timing for the AWC Video Progression module.
The transition feels too rushed. I need to extend the end segment.
How long should the end segment be?
Make the PI wordform end segment lasts 30 seconds during the video progression. That gives enough time to read it.
Updated. Does that affect the total runtime?
Yes, it adds about ten seconds. I'll fix the total duration later.
Is it raining outside? I forgot my umbrella.
It is currently drizzling in your area.
